title: The recording is still a test

fauna_scope.reason: Authentic research interface and source evidence contain no staged habitat or animal placement.

divergence_note: This film interrogates authentic research-app screens and their source limitations through exact excerpts and short diagrams. It uses a phone interface, source-record typography and explicit example graphs, rather than the prior lease-retrieval geometry or borrowed reading footage.

fingerprint.palette: deep clinical green and pale source paper
fingerprint.metaphor: a recorded signal without a diagnosis

captions.text: A phone recording isn't a diagnosis.
Womb Watch is recruiting in Austin, Houston and Galveston.
The study uploads phone recordings to a Texas computing center.
Artificial intelligence estimates movement, breathing and hiccups.
The app is designed to return those movement patterns.
Researchers are testing daily use and tracking participants' anxiety.
The app's own instructions say it isn't intended to determine decreased fetal movements.
An analyzed recording still isn't a diagnosis.

candidates.reason: Shows the actual interface for the daily recording task. Preserve the displayed number as a source example; never animate it as observed live use.
Shows the specific practical failure that can require a new recording; this is a designed example, not a participant failure rate.
A tight crop to the caution communicates the clinical boundary. Do not imply the thumbnail is playable footage or identify the clinician without source confirmation.

Independent validator inspected the genuine prototype Trends screenshot and permits intended-interface explanation with persistent Protocol example / Not study results disclosure, no numerical interpretation or health inference.
Inspected original protocol paragraph that explicitly connects participant feedback with anxiety assessments; use a short exact glyph excerpt.

visual_research.decision: Use the exact protocol recording, failure, instruction and prototype trend examples, with persistent source-example disclosure, short source-glyph excerpts and two source-bound diagram treatments. No prior-day media, stock filler or live participant outcome is depicted.
visual_research.prior_edition_comparison: September 28 used Battalion/Collide/lease imagery. These Womb Watch source-document assets are unrelated and newly fetched; director must retain final hash/URL prior-edition check.
